survey.notes: 98 of 1112 known pages surveyed, stopped at saturation (last new feature on page 56). Site-wide: svg icons 95%, blurred sticky header 70%, card grid 70%. Common: illustrations 44%, large product images 35%, CSS animation 34%, disclosure 34%, video 30%, breadcrumb 28%, hairline line drawings 20%, transitions 20%, loops 19%, theme toggle 19% (docs/developers/learn/enablement only). Occasional: marquee 12%, logo wall 11%, quote 11%, badge 10%, carousel 10%, svg motion 9%, code block 9%, table 7%, canvas 7%, reveal 6%. One-offs: form 4%, draw-on 3%, rotate 3%, tabs 1%, choice 1%. p4 (join-slack) redirected to a third-party chat-service invite page and is excluded as noise, including its fonts, CSS variables, facepile motion, checkbox form and cookie banner. Captured CSS custom properties all belong to that third-party page; 30-58 stylesheets per page were cross-origin/inaccessible, so the site's own token names were not readable - every value here is measured from computed styles and pixels instead.

character.summary: A near-black instrument panel: #08090A ground over 83% of the painted area, four lifted greys, hairline 1px white-alpha edges and an Inter-style sans at weight 510 with tight negative tracking, where the hero of every page is the product's own UI set on a dim, spotlit stage that fades into the dark. The machine's states are told in a private visual dialect - 5x5 dot-matrix glyphs that step through frames, shimmer sweeping across 'working' text, isometric 0.5px hairline blueprints labelled with mono uppercase figure captions and marching dashes. Color is almost absent: one indigo for focus and selection, and small status glyphs in yellow, green, orange and red, so everything reads as precise, quiet and engineered.

color.notes: Dark is the identity: every marketing, product, pricing, customers, changelog and contact page renders html[data-theme=dark] with no switch (theme.json), and #08090A covers 83% of painted area. Light exists only behind the 'Toggle theme' control on docs, developers, learn and enablement pages (survey ui:theme-toggle 19%); it is observed for prose, sidebars, cards, code blocks and tables (screenshots/p2-desktop-toggled.png, p7, p10) but never for the signature elements - the light versions of the spotlit stage, isometric blueprints and dot matrix are derived and flagged. Recommendation: ship both, dark as default and primary. Accent budget: indigo only on focus rings, the selected nav item, switches/checkboxes and at most one primary icon button - 3 uses per screen at most; primary CTAs are the inverse pill (#E5E5E6 on dark), not indigo. Status hues appear only as 14-16px glyphs, 6px dots or thin chart marks, never as fills larger than a badge. Customer quote cards in brand hues (lime #E4F222, pastel blue) are third-party brand color - noise.

motion.reducedMotion: The reference gates its loops behind @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) (status-dot flash/pulse, disclosure slide, chevron rotate, smooth scroll), sets transition:none on chart lines under reduce, hides a decorative chip column (display:none) and kills toast animation (motion.json reducedMotionRules). The template does the same: under reduce, dot-matrix glyphs freeze on a meaningful static frame (all dots at 0.3 with a filled center column for 'working', full grid for 'done'), shimmer and border sweep stop (text stays at full secondary color), marching dashes and chevrons stop, carets stay visible, scroll settle snaps to the end state, hover/press color changes keep but scale(0.971) is dropped.
motion.notes: Two speeds: state changes are fast (100ms ease 38% of transitions, 160ms quad-out 13%, 250ms ease 21% - styles.json transition) while ambient loops are slow and mechanical (steps(1) frame-stepping, constant-speed dashes). There is no bounce, no parallax beyond the one perspective stack, and no fade-up-on-scroll for ordinary text. The legacy 2020 release page (p3) uses a 20s blurred blob morph, gradient frames and a letter-spacing reveal - an older era of the brand, a one-off, not part of the current language. The hero video on feature pages (p6) is a perspective field of product chips with depth blur (motion/p6-v1.png) - recorded footage, rebuildable only as a CSS 3D field.

layout.grid: Marketing: fixed 1344px content frame inside a 1440 viewport (48px outer margin), text column inset to 80px from the viewport edge; section openers are a 2-column split (headline left in the first half, 24px description + text link right starting at 50%); card grids are 3 or 4 columns separated by 1px vertical hairlines rather than boxed cards; pricing 4 columns with hairline separators; footer 6 columns (logo + 5 link groups). Docs: 3 columns - 280px sidebar with right hairline, prose column about 650px (max 1160 frame), on-page TOC about 200px with a 1px left rule and a 2px active marker.
layout.notes: Breakpoints from styles.json mediaQueries: 1280, 1024, 768, 640, 600 (+ hover/pointer queries to gate hover effects). Header is fixed, 72px + 1px hairline, backdrop-filter blur(20px), background #08090A turning transparent-over-blur once scrolled (structure.json). On mobile (screenshots/p1-mobile-light.png) the header keeps logo + 'Log in' + inverse pill + menu icon; the split section opener stacks; product stages bleed to the viewport edge and are cropped rather than scaled; logo row becomes a horizontal marquee (survey motion:marquee 12%). Marketing reads airy (160px section gaps) while product UI inside stages is compact (28-32px rows) - the system should be 'airy frame, dense content'.

theming.notes: Marketing pages are fixed dark: html[data-theme='dark'] + color-scheme: dark, no switch, the single prefers-color-scheme rule belongs to an embedded tweet widget (theme.json). Docs, developers, learn and enablement pages carry a sun/moon 'Toggle theme' icon button in the top bar; toggling flips body rgb(8,9,10) -> rgb(255,255,255) (theme.json p2, p7, p10). In light: page #FFFFFF, sidebar/cards #FAFAFA, code #F9F8F9, borders #E9E8EA, text #282A30/#3C4149/#6F6E77, the inverse CTA becomes a dark pill (#282A30 bg, white text), product screenshots stay dark (screenshots/p2-desktop-toggled.png) and focus stays indigo. Nothing else changes: same radii, type, spacing. Appearance recommendation: both, dark default.

imagery.iconography: 16px glyphs on a 16px grid (20px in composers), mostly solid fills built from simple geometry (circles, rounded bars, chevrons), a minority 1.5px strokes with butt caps (inventory.json strokeWidths 1.5px); idle #62666D/#8A8F98, active #F7F8F8, colored only when the icon is a status (yellow half-filled ring = in progress, green check-in-circle = done, empty ring = todo, orange/red = urgent/bug). Priority shown as 3 ascending bars. Status dots 6px. A 16px dot-matrix glyph (25 dots) stands for 'agent working' (inventory.json p1 icon 688, 25 shapes, animated).
imagery.illustration: Isometric hairline blueprints: rounded-vertex isometric slabs and boxes drawn with 0.5px strokes, fill equal to the page ground (#08090A) so shapes occlude what is behind them, near/top edges #D0D6E0, hidden/back edges #2E2E32-#3E3E44 with round caps, a soft drop-shadow filter under each slab, occasional dashed construction lines and chevrons, tiny 5x5 dot grids on top faces, all on a near-black panel with a 12px mono 'FIG 0.n' caption top-left (raw/svg/p1-i3.svg, p1-i5.svg; illustrations/p1-i3.png, p1-i4.png, p1-i5.png, motion/p6-v3.png). Blog/news thumbnails use the same monochrome generative-line vocabulary: helices of dots, hairline fans, dot matrices, ellipse orbits in grey on #0F1011 (screenshots/p11-desktop-light.png). No characters, no hand-drawn wobble, no color fills.
imagery.photography: Black-and-white or desaturated portrait/event photography only on customer and press pages, cropped 16:9 at 8px radius, often with a white customer wordmark overlaid (third-party marks - noise). Product video is the UI itself, autoplaying muted and looping (media:autoplay-video 15%). Docs use dark product screenshots even in light mode.

signatures.name: Spotlit product stage
signatures.what: The page's main image is the product's own interface, rendered live in HTML at true scale, set inside a 1344px-wide panel (8px radius, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05) edge) whose ground is lit by a cool-grey radial light from the top or bottom edge (peak about #7A7F83 at the edge center, #45494A at the corners, back to #08090A by about 600px - pixels from screenshots/p6-desktop-light.png rows 1225-1900). The UI window inside (bg #0F1011, raised-panel shadow) is inset about 56px and fades out to the ground on the right and/or bottom edge via a mask; secondary windows overlap at 50-80% opacity and blur. A bold 15px caption + 2 grey lines sits bottom-left inside the panel.
signatures.frequency: Hero of the home page and every product feature page, plus 4-7 sections per feature page (p6 has 7); media:large-image 35% and video 30% of surveyed pages are mostly this; docs pages embed the same dark UI screenshots even in light mode (p2).
signatures.recipe: Markup:
signatures.motion: Static frame; the content inside may live: rows appear with a 300ms opacity fade (chat-turn pattern), carets blink 1250ms steps, dot-matrix glyphs loop. On feature pages a perspective stack of cards settles on scroll over 700ms cubic-bezier(0.645,0.045,0.355,1): translateY(16px) scale(1.05) blur(2px) -> translateY(-32px) scale(0.9) blur(0). Reduced motion: final state, no blur.

applicationMap.use: Full-width stage directly under the headline, lit from below, showing the product's core screen.
The page header area shows the selected metric's chart in a mini-stage (240px tall, light from top at 60% strength) instead of a hero banner.
A preview stage next to appearance/notification settings rendering the live result of the setting.
Each step is a stage with the real UI region highlighted and the rest faded by the mask.
A small stage (360x200) showing a ghosted, faded sample row of what will appear, plus one sentence and one pill button.
Screenshots of UI are framed as stages (8px radius, hairline, fade at bottom), dark even in light mode.
One stage above the table showing the feature that differs between plans.
A dim stage with the light source turned to 30% and a single faded window showing the missing object's outline.

signatures.limits: One stage per viewport height; never more than one lit stage visible at once. Never behind body text, forms or tables - stages contain UI, they are not backgrounds. Dense screens (tables, settings lists) use at most a 200-240px mini-stage or none. The light peak never exceeds #7A7F83 on dark (no bright white glows). Reduced motion: static.

signatures.name: Dot-matrix status glyph
signatures.what: A 5x5 grid of tiny circles (16px glyph: 2px dots on a 3px pitch; 96px loader in sandbox blocks) whose dots switch between opacity 0.3 and 1 in discrete frames to draw patterns - a bouncing pixel, rising/falling bars, an hourglass, an implosion. It is the system's 'machine is working' sign, used in place of spinners, and its dot vocabulary repeats in charts (scatter clusters), the closing-CTA dot field and blog thumbnails.
signatures.frequency: Home and every agent/coding page: 75 animated dots on p1 (3 loaders), 100+ on p5 (motion.json); svg motion 9% and loops 19% of pages are mostly these; the dot vocabulary appears in charts (p1-v2), thumbnails (p11) and a canvas dot field behind the closing CTA (p5 canvas 1440x676).
signatures.recipe: SVG viewBox 0 0 15 15, 25 <circle r='1' cx='1.5+3i' cy='1.5+3j'> filled currentColor (text.body #D0D6E0 on dark, text.primary #282A30 on light). Each dot gets its own @keyframes with N equal frames (N=8 to 14) and animation-timing-function: steps(1); each frame sets opacity 1 (lit) or 0.3 (unlit). Author patterns as a frame table: 'pong' - one lit dot travels a zigzag (8 frames, 960-1600ms); 'rise' - columns fill bottom-up then drain (14 frames, 2800ms); 'agent' - a 3x3 core pulses outward (3200ms); 'hourglass' (6 frames, 600ms); one-shots 'empty' (200ms) and 'burst' (1080ms, ends all unlit) for start/finish. Generate keyframes from a JS frame array so new patterns are data. Sizes: 12, 16 (default), 24, 48, 96px - scale the viewBox, never the dot count. Done state: all 25 lit for 400ms then swap to a check glyph.
signatures.motion: Loop, infinite, steps(1), durations 600 / 960 / 1600 / 2800 / 3200ms by pattern; one-shot intro 200ms and outro 1080ms. Reduced motion: freeze on a designed static frame (center column lit = working; all lit = done).

applicationMap.use: 16px glyph next to 'Loading results' text instead of a spinner, pattern 'pong'.
Row-level 12px glyph in the status column for syncing/processing rows; finished rows swap to a static status ring.
Live widget headers show a 12px 'rise' glyph while data refreshes; charts draw points as dots that scale in 420ms.
Inside the pressed pill button the label stays and a 12px glyph replaces the trailing arrow until the response.
48px glyph frozen on a sparse frame (3 lit dots) above the message - 'nothing here yet' in the system's own alphabet.
48px glyph frozen with an X pattern lit in status.danger at 0.8, the rest at 0.3; no animation.
16px 'agent' loop at the left of a progress toast; becomes a green check when done.
A faint full-width dot field (dots 1px, 12px pitch, opacity 0.08-0.15) behind closing CTAs or section ends.

signatures.limits: At most 3 animated glyphs visible at once and only for real in-progress work - never decorative idle loops. Never larger than 96px. Dot fields stay at opacity 0.15 or below and never sit behind text smaller than 24px. Reduced motion: all frozen.

signatures.name: Isometric hairline blueprint
signatures.what: Explanatory drawings built from isometric slabs and boxes with rounded vertices, drawn in 0.5px strokes: near/top edges #D0D6E0, hidden or inner edges #2E2E32-#3E3E44 with round caps, faces filled with the ground color #08090A so stacked shapes occlude each other, a soft drop shadow under each slab, dashed construction lines, small chevrons showing flow, a tiny 5x5 dot grid or striped disc as a top-face mark. Each sits on a near-black panel with a 12px mono uppercase caption like 'FIG 0.2' top-left and a 15px/510 title + grey description below.
signatures.frequency: svg:line-drawing on 20% and svg:illustration on 44% of pages; the home page opens its first content section with three of them; feature pages use one per integration/automation section (p6); motion:draw-on 3%.
signatures.recipe: SVG, fill='none' root, strokes at stroke-width 0.5 (vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke at small sizes). Isometric projection 2:1 (30deg): a slab top is a rhombus whose four corners are rounded with arcs of about 7-8% of the slab width (path: 'a7.75 7.75 0 0 1 6.932 0' style arcs at each vertex), sides are vertical drops of 16-120px. Paint order per slab: shadow copy (fill bg.page, filter drop-shadow 0 8px 12px #08090A + 0 0 68px #08090A), body (fill bg.page, stroke line.front), back seam (stroke line.back, linecap round). Stack slabs 16-17px apart for layered 'systems'; separate two slabs vertically with dashed 1px connectors (stroke-dasharray 2 4) and 3 chevrons per flow direction. Colors by token: line.front = text.body, line.back = border.ring/#2E2E32, marks = text.tertiary. Caption: mono 12px uppercase text.tertiary 'FIG 0.1'. Subjects are abstract system parts (layers, stacks, blocks, ports) for the product being built - never logos or brand marks. Light (derived): faces #FFFFFF, front edges #3C4149, back edges #D6D7DA, shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.06).
signatures.motion: Loop: connectors march - stroke-dashoffset 0 -> -8px (straight) or -6px (isometric) over 1000ms `linear`, infinite, opposite flows reversed; chevrons translate 0 -> 48px over 2500ms `linear` infinite inside a fade mask. Hover/scroll-in: slabs lift apart by up to 32px (custom property --lift, staggered 0-120ms, 700ms cubic-bezier(0.645,0.045,0.355,1)). Reduced motion: static, slabs at rest.

applicationMap.use: A row of 3 captioned blueprints (FIG 0.1-0.3), 260-300px each, above titled descriptions.
A 160px blueprint of two slabs with marching connectors between the product and the connected service; connector stops when disconnected.
A single 120-160px slab stack in line.back only (dimmed), FIG-style mono caption with the object name, one line of text, one pill button.
Each step's illustration is a blueprint that adds one slab per completed step (lift-in 700ms).
Architecture explanations drawn as blueprints with mono callout labels at the sides.
Two slabs with a broken dashed connector (gap in the middle, not moving) and status.danger at the break point.
Only in the empty/first-run state of a widget, 80-96px, no motion.
Tier headers carry a small blueprint whose slab count grows with the tier (1-4 slabs).

signatures.limits: Maximum 3 per screen and only one animated. Minimum 80px wide (hairlines vanish below); never inside table cells, form fields or buttons. Never colored fills; status color only at a single point (break, active port). Never trace the reference's drawings or include third-party logos on the top faces.

signatures.name: Working shimmer and live edges
signatures.what: Text and edges that show something is happening: a highlight band sweeps across 'Thinking...'-style status text (span translateX 0 -> 100% over 75% of a 2400ms cycle, then a pause); status badges carry a gradient border that slides (background-position-x 0 -> 120px, 2000ms ease, infinite); live dots pulse a ring (scale 0.375 -> 1, opacity 0.7 -> 0, 2000ms); text carets blink in hard steps (1250ms). All of it is monochrome or at most one status hue.
signatures.frequency: Every agent/AI conversation mock on home and feature pages (p1, p5, p6, p13), the system-status dot on contact (p9); motion:loop 19% of pages.
signatures.recipe: Shimmer: Working...; color text.secondary; ::after (or an inner span) with the same text in text.primary clipped by background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, #000 50%, transparent 100%) as mask-image, width 40%, animated transform translateX(-100%) -> translateX(250%) via keyframes 0% start, 75% end, 100% end; 2400ms `linear` infinite. Live edge: border 1px transparent, background: linear-gradient(bg.raised,bg.raised) padding-box, linear-gradient(90deg, border.solid 0%, text.secondary 50%, border.solid 100%) border-box; background-size 120px 100%; animate background-position-x 0 -> 120px 2000ms ease infinite. Pulse dot: 6px circle status color; ::after same size, animation scale(.375)->scale(1), opacity .7 -> 0 at 60%, hold, 2000ms ease infinite; dot itself filter brightness(1) -> 1.6 at 8%. Caret: 1.5px x 1em bar text.primary, opacity 1 for 49%, 0 for 50%, steps(1), 1250ms.
signatures.motion: Loops: shimmer 2400ms `linear`, edge sweep 2000ms ease, pulse 2000ms ease, caret 1250ms steps(1). Turn-in of new lines: opacity 0 -> 1 300ms. Reduced motion: shimmer and sweep removed (static text.secondary, static border.solid), pulse removed (dot stays), caret stays visible.

applicationMap.use: 'Thinking' and tool-step lines shimmer; each finished step fades in 300ms and stops shimmering.
A row being processed gets a live edge on its status badge only; the row text never shimmers.
A 'Live' pulse dot next to real-time widgets; disappears when data is stale (dot turns text.tertiary, no pulse).
Async field validation shows a shimmering 12px 'Checking...' helper line under the field.
Skeleton text lines are bg.raised bars with the same 2400ms sweep at 6% white instead of a pulsing grey.
Service status row: green pulse dot + 'Operational'; incident = orange dot, no pulse, plus text.
Progress toast headline shimmers until completion, then becomes static with a check.

signatures.limits: Only for genuinely in-progress or live states - never on headings, CTAs or static labels. Maximum 2 shimmering lines and 1 sweeping edge per screen. Pulse dots only for live/real-time indicators. Reduced motion: all loops off.

signatures.name: Split opener with two-tone voice and mono figures
signatures.what: A typographic composition that opens every section: a hairline across the full width, then a 48px/510 headline (-0.022em, two short lines with a forced break) in the left half and, from the 50% line, a 24px/400 description in #D0D6E0 with a small grey text link ending in '+' or an arrow. Statement paragraphs set a bright lead sentence (#F7F8F8) continuing in grey (#8A8F98) at the same size. Small 12px mono uppercase labels number figures ('FIG 0.1'), caption diagrams, date timelines and list items ('01. CHAT').
signatures.frequency: 4 split openers on the home page, 7 on the build page; two-tone statements on home, coding sessions (3), customers; mono captions on home, feature pages, changelog strips (now, home).
signatures.recipe:
Section: border-top 1px border.subtle; padding-top 160px (desktop) / 96px (mobile). Grid: 2 equal columns, gap 32px; left h2 font 48px/1.0 weight 510 letter-spacing -0.022em text.primary, text-wrap: balance, max 2 lines; right p 24px/1.33 weight 400 letter-spacing -0.012em text.body max-width 30ch, then 32px gap and a link 15px text.secondary with trailing ' +' or ' ->' (arrow as an inline 12px glyph). Two-tone:

Lead sentence. continuation...

where b keeps the same weight as the rest (510 at 48px, 400 at 24px) and only changes color: b text.primary, the rest text.secondary. Mono label: font mono 12px/1.4 uppercase letter-spacing 0, text.tertiary; numbers zero-padded ('0.1', '01.'). Mobile: columns stack, headline 32px, description 17px.
signatures.motion: Static. The reference does not animate these texts (no fade-up on scroll); one delayed 1000ms opacity fade on a small 'New' link in the hero is the only text motion.

applicationMap.use: Every section opens with the split opener; the closing CTA is the centered 72px variant.
Each settings group opens with a compact split: 15px/510 title left, 13px text.secondary description right, hairline above - same structure at product density.
Page header is a split: page title 24px/510 left, a two-tone one-line summary right ('12 open. 3 need review.' with the first clause bright).
Column header row and timestamps use the mono label style; table caption is a two-tone sentence.
Mono caption ('NO RESULTS') above a two-tone 17px sentence.
Dates and version labels in mono, entries hung from a dot timeline.
Section headers in long forms use the split; step numbers in mono ('02 / 04').

signatures.limits: Mono is only for labels, numbers, dates, code and captions - never for headings or body. Two-tone only on statements of 1-3 sentences, once per section. Split opener needs at least 720px of width; below it stacks. Never more than one 48px+ headline per viewport.

writing.casing: Sentence case everywhere: headings, nav, buttons ('Get started', 'Contact sales', 'Log in'). Uppercase only in mono labels and captions.
writing.tone: Plain, confident, engineering register: short declaratives, product verbs (plan, build, ship, review, triage), few adjectives, no exclamation marks, no emoji.
writing.notes: Display headlines often split into two short lines and may end in a period when they are full sentences; two-sentence closers ('X for the future. Y today.' pattern). Section descriptions are 2-3 lines, about 20-30 words. Links say what they open and end in an arrow or '+'. Numbers are shown precisely (40,000 / 2.0x / 0.10s). Dates in mono 'OCT 8, 2026' style in strips, 'Oct 8, 2026' in prose. Em dashes are used in descriptions.

Sentence case, short declaratives, mono uppercase captions.

doNot: Do not use pure black #000000 or pure white body text on dark - ground is #08090A and body is #D0D6E0.
Do not make the indigo a brand fill: no indigo primary buttons, headers or large areas; the primary CTA is the inverse pill.
Do not use drop shadows larger than 28px blur or colored glows; depth is rings, inset highlights and grey steps.
Do not use spinners, bouncing dots or progress circles - use the dot-matrix glyph or shimmer.
Do not use stock illustrations, characters, 3D renders or gradient blobs; drawings are 0.5px isometric hairlines.
Do not set headings in bold 700 or with positive tracking; headings are 510-590 with negative tracking.
Do not box every card; grids are divided by hairlines, boxes only for clickable link cards.
Do not use mono for headings or paragraphs.
Do not fade-up every block on scroll; text is static, only stages and charts move in.
Do not mix corner styles: controls are pills, panels 8px, nothing in between rounder than 16px.
ipRisks: Brand names and product/feature names: Linear, linear.app, Linear Pulse, Linear Method, Linear Asks, Linear Insights, Linear Agent, Linear MCP, Linear Diffs - never in the template, name, tokens or prose.
The logo: a circle cut by parallel diagonal stripes, and any glyph built from parallel diagonal lines inside a circle or rounded square.

Third-party marks shown on the site: customer and partner logos (OpenAI, Vercel, Salesforce, Figma, Cursor, Coinbase, Ramp, Oscar, Brex, Opendoor, Automattic, Cars24, Scale, Boom, Dandelion, Sierra, Anthropic/Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub, GitLab, Slack and others) and their brand colors on quote cards (lime #E4F222, etc.).
Berkeley Mono (commercial) - substitute Geist Mono or JetBrains Mono (OFL). 'SF Pro Display' in the fallback chain is Apple-proprietary - do not name it; Inter (OFL) is fine.

Specific artwork: the isometric drawings (striped disc on a slab, the git octocat slab pair, the cube cluster, the comb of fins), blog thumbnails, the hero chip-field video, the legacy release app-icon with gradient glow - describe the style, never trace.
Product mock content: issue IDs (ENG-/DRV-/MWT- prefixes), names of people, feature names (Triage Intelligence, Cycles, Initiatives), code samples and copy, taglines and headline wording.
The third-party chat-service invite page (join-slack) - fonts (Slack-Lato, Salesforce Avant Garde), colors, facepile animation and cookie banner are not the site.
